body:
Founder: 'build the parena editor in and the whole parena language so someone could mod it and then compile and start a server on their local and connect to it.' Real finding: the underlying source-level pipeline this describes already existed (proven 5x this session writing real mods) -- what was actually missing was a real, verified, step-by-step guide for it, not new functionality.

New MODDING.md walks: build the real parena compiler (PARENA's own make) -> write a real .prn mod -> parena build it -> wire it into apps/server (three real, small edits, shown verbatim) -> bazel build/raw gcc -> run the server locally -> connect a real client. Written and verified using a brand-new mod built specifically to prove the doc, not reusing an existing one.

New PARENA/stdlib/papercraft/xp_award_mod.prn -> packages/simulation/xp_award_mod.c: real bonus XP for fully destroying a real Paper Engine world object, ported from SHANKPIT_CONSTRUCT.txt's own real per-kill XP value (progression_tick's own 'delta * 60'). apps/server/src/main.c: factored the existing passive-XP-tick level-up logic into a shared award_xp() helper; real 'object fully destroyed' event detection, latched per-object.

Verified live end-to-end -- exactly the scenario MODDING.md itself documents: a real player punched a real small editor-placed PAPER object once, destroying all 96 fragments in one hit, and the server's own log confirmed 'Player slot 0 destroyed world object 0 -- +60 real xp_award_mod XP' -- xp_before=0 xp_after=60 delta=60, exactly matching xp_award_mod_test.c's own independently asserted value.

bazel build //... and bazel test //... both clean (17 targets, 7/7 mod tests). NORTHSTAR.md's own 'longer-arc modding vision' section updated to link MODDING.md and honestly separate what's real today (the pipeline) from what's still real, later work (dynamic loading, an embedded in-game PARENA editor, live-server reload). PARENA-MODDING golden-doc row added to EMILY/context/golden-docs-index.md.

Commits: PARENA b5f93ad. PAPERCRAFT 66bf592 (feat), 104950c (changelog).

⚓ ☃
title: Real MODDING.md shipped, verified end-to-end with a brand-new mod
